title: Special Executive Programme In Corporate Management And Control
description: The course aims to equip learners with strategic knowledge and skills to effectively manage and control corporate governance and risk management functions within an organization.
longDescription: The Special Executive Program in Corporate Management and Control aims to enable the learner to understand the fundamentals of corporate governance structure and functions and their respective controls so that the learner is able to point out the discrepancies in performance and reporting on the corporate level. The course aims to enable the learner with tools and technique to identify, analyze and prepare to deal with risk emanating from the corporate management and control. The learner will be prepared to better deals with internal and external controls issues.
courseDetails: This program focuses on the essential components of corporate governance, including internal and external control functions, corporate risk management, and governance structures. Learners will examine models of corporate governance, control systems for safeguarding corporate assets, and the role of financial statements as internal controls. The course also covers enterprise risk management techniques to identify, assess, and mitigate risks within organizations, with a focus on practical applications for listed companies.
